What's Inside the 14-Page Guide

The 10 moves, by urgency

Built from Ann Werts' April 9, 2026 Weber State workshop — where 42 federal employees got walked through the exact moves most feds miss in the 5 years before retirement.

01Download your eOPF before you walk out the door
02Audit your SF-50s and beneficiary forms
03Price out a military buyback (often pays for itself in year 1)
04Know which of the three doors you're walking through
05Work the 1.1% multiplier — a 10% raise on your pension, for life
06Convert unused sick leave into creditable service
07Pick the right retirement date (worth thousands)
08Lock in FEHB for the rest of your life — the 5-year rule
09Don't get blindsided by the 2026 Roth catch-up mandate
10Set up your state tax withholding yourself — OPM won't
